oliver: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands reliability Q&A. Dropping the RCA link + a compact set of owners so we can close the loop outside the meeting.

oliver: RCA: https://internal.redwood.ai/rca/INC-2026-2048 (short TL;DR: routing preference drift + unhandled cross-region spill; full timeline + artifacts in doc).

maya: thanks. one clarifying Q for leadership: does the roadmap item for routing validation need to be a quarter priority or an immediate sprint task?

raj: product/eng sync decision: prioritize it next sprint as a safety gate for deployments; we'll add a lightweight config validator first, then a deeper policy change in Q3.

sophia: i'll take the config validator (small server-side check + telemetry). ETA: end of next week.

ops-bot: canary-deploy: pref-fix-canary-2026-05-01T20:08Z -> success (automated).

kevin: i'll own post-rollout verification (latency p95/p99, error-rate, cache-hit); will post 2h and 24h notes.

leah: comms: recommend short status page wording once leaders sign off. Suggested internal line: "Mitigation in place; code fix & validation in progress; monitoring ongoing."
tom: accepted: route-applier defensive patch -> tom (due: 2026-05-07).
sophia: accepted: config validator + telemetry -> sophia (due: 2026-05-08).
kevin: accepted: post-rollout verification -> kevin (first note due: 2026-05-03).
sara: accepted: status blurb draft & staging -> sara (pending verification).

oliver: ACTIONS (also mirrored to tracker):
- tom: defensive route-applier patch + unit tests (owner: tom; due 2026-05-07)
- sophia: config validator (soft-flag for 1 week + telemetry) (owner: sophia; due 2026-05-08)
- kevin: post-rollout perf checks (2h & 24h) (owner: kevin; first note due 2026-05-03)
- sara: draft + stage status page blurb; publish after green signoff (owner: sara; pending)

oliver: please react when you pick up your item so I can update the tracker. call out blockers here.

maya: small ask  can we add a short onboarding test for routing sanity? would reduce future regressions.

raj: yes, add to model-onboarding checklist; @maya can draft and ping devex.

sophia: minor blocker  need read access to the region-fallback logs to validate telemetry; @ops-bot can you open access?

ops-bot: access-request submitted for sophia -> region-fallback-logs (expect approval in ~12m).

kevin: starting 2h verifications now; will paste short notes to the tracker.

sara: drafting blurb now; will share in this thread for quick review before publish.

oliver: thanks everyone. we'll close items in the tracker and review progress in next ops sync. :white_check_mark:
